title: EngonowEventEnvelope
description: Standardized event envelope wrapping all Kafka messages within the ENGONOW event-driven architecture.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this specific event instance.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key uniquely identifying the business operation to prevent duplicate processing.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the business action occurred (ISO-8601 UTC).

producedAt.description: Timestamp when this event was serialized and emitted to Kafka (ISO-8601 UTC).

traceId.description: W3C traceparent or distributed tracing context ID.

correlationId.description: Business correlation identifier linking all events across an asynchronous evaluation lifecycle.

source.description: Originating microservice or worker (e.g., engonow-lms-backend, ai-writing-worker).

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts executed for this message.

payload.description: Domain-specific event payload matching the eventType schema.
